ma.downloadFile(Object object)

Download file resources to a local path. The client directly initiates an HTTPS GET request and returns the local temporary path (local path) of the file. Note: Specify a proper Content-Type field in the header of the response from the server to ensure that the client can correctly process the file type.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes URL of the resource to be downloaded.
header Object No Header of an HTTP request. Referer cannot be set in the header.
timeout Number 60000 No Timeout duration, in milliseconds.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.success Callback Function
Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String downloadFile: ok
tempFilePath String Temporary file path (local path). This parameter is returned when the file storage path specified by filePath is not transferred. The downloaded files are stored in a temporary file path.
statusCode Number HTTP status code returned by the developer server.(The success callback is triggered only when the download is successful. The status code is 2XX. In other abnormal scenarios, such as 404 and 500 requests, the failure callback is triggered.)

Sample Code

ma.downloadFile({
  url: 'https://example.com/audio/123', // Example resource.
  success(res) {
    // As long as the server has response data, the response content is written to the file and the success callback is called. The service needs to determine whether the required content is downloaded.
    if (res.statusCode === 200) {
      ma.playVoice({
        filePath: res.tempFilePath
      });
    }
  }
});

Bug & Tip

  1. tip: Currently, the security domain is not verified. You are advised to use HTTPS.
